shared_elements: human figure with stylised head/hair rendered in shallow relief
justification: Both are stone carvings that reduce the human body to broad, smooth masses with details incised in very shallow relief, and both include small circular/disc motifs and repeated linear striations (hair in A, banding on the torso in B). But A is a flat, horizontally banded frieze with a processional row of figures, animals and a tree bounded by rosette borders, while B is a three-dimensional freestanding monolithic figure whose sparse ornament wraps a curved body — no correspondence in format, composition or subject.
